name: Entities Import
description: Provides a UI to import entity data (content and taxonomy) from Excel or CSV files.
project_description: Entities Import adds an administrative UI for bulk-importing Drupal content entities (nodes) and taxonomy terms from Excel (xlsx/xls) or CSV files, without writing a migration. An administrator creates one or more 'Entities Import Type' config entities, each of which selects a target entity type (Content type or Vocabulary), the spreadsheet columns to treat as unique keys (used to decide create vs. update), the column used as the title/name, and a folder path for file/image fields. Uploading a spreadsheet against an import type runs a Batch API job that reads the file with the phpoffice/phpspreadsheet library and creates or updates one entity per row. It supports core field types (text, number, date and date range, entity reference to content or taxonomy, file/image) as well as Paragraph fields via an encoded multi-value column syntax, and can target a specific language by including a langcode column or choosing a language code on the import type. The module requires the phpoffice/phpspreadsheet library, so it must be installed with Composer.
